answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a refundable stake and a liveness proof per identity. Every agent emits a signed pulse regularly, proving it is unique and live; a new identity joins only via a trusted raven with a signed referral token. All identities harbor in a registry cross-checking stake against heartbeat cadence. An attacker running many puppets must lock separate capital and sustain a distinct pulse per identity, and a failing vouched raven slashes its referrer's stake. Each fake identity costs real locked funds plus continuous presence, making sybil swarms capital-prohibitive.
